prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create ONE refined pure typographic wordmark logo for the app "OtherWise", with a cosmic / universe theme.
Exact text, verbatim: "OtherWise". Capital O and capital W, all other letters lowercase. Spell O-t-h-e-r-W-i-s-e correctly. It must read as ONE continuous word with consistent baseline and harmonious spacing. No gap between Other and Wise beyond normal letter spacing.
The text itself is the ONLY logo. Absolutely no standalone symbols, icons, stars, sparkles, planets, orbital rings, galaxies, rocket ships, illustrations, badges, extra text, labels or slogans. No ornaments above or below the wordmark. The dot of the lowercase i stays a simple circular dot.
Two-color typography: "Other" entirely luminous periwinkle / starfield blue #8FA6FF; "Wise" entirely soft starlight silver #EEEAF5. Keep each word segment internally one consistent color. Do not mix colors within letters; no rainbow, no colorful nebula fill.
Universe theme comes ONLY through the typography and the dark background: a sophisticated custom geometric sans serif, moderately wide letterforms, clean rounded O, subtly futuristic precise cuts, open counters, an elegant broad W. Medium-to-semibold weight that feels calm and intelligent, NOT harsh videogame lettering, NOT generic techno stencil, NOT overly spaced sci-fi title typography. Friendly but sophisticated personal discovery brand. Subtle almost imperceptible soft halo near letter edges is allowed, but preserve crisp flat readable shapes.
Composition: landscape image about 3:1, deep space navy solid background #080D1B, wordmark centered and occupying roughly 80% of the width, generous balanced negative space above and below. Highest graphic clarity, carefully drawn professional brand typography. Present a finished standalone logo exploration, no presentation board, no multiple samples, no mockup, no texture, no shadows, no gradients in letters, no watermark.
